LanguageData.RR_DoorCross_Desc:
Order a selected colonist or animal to cross here.
Select who you mean first. Anyone who cannot cross is listed with the reason rather than left out.
LanguageData.RR_DoorCross_NobodySelected: Select a colonist or animal first
LanguageData.RR_Event_AccountFiled: {0}: the company has filed {1}’s account after an interview by {2}. The disagreeing account stays on the record.
LanguageData.RR_Portals_ApproachCellReserved: {0} needs this cell to be stood on. Lay a floor here if you like, but nothing can be built on it while the gate holds an address. Build one cell over, or clear the address first.
LanguageData.RR_Portals_Explanation: Remembered addresses connect a real door on this map to the saved return threshold of a Backrooms coordinate. A laboratory address needs its designated gate, power and operator; a natural threshold stays open permanently.
LanguageData.RR_Portals_NoBranch: No company branch is active, so no address can be remembered.
LanguageData.RR_Portals_NetworkFault: The saved connection network could not be read. Its records are retained for review and no gate operation is available.
LanguageData.RR_Portals_NoAddresses: No addresses are remembered yet. Select a coordinate below and remember it on the designated gate.
LanguageData.RR_Portals_StatusClosed: closed — open the gate for this address
LanguageData.RR_Portals_StatusEndpointMissing: endpoint unavailable — the record is retained for diagnosis
LanguageData.RR_Portals_NoCoordinates: This branch has no coordinate records.
LanguageData.RR_Portals_RememberLaboratory: Remember this coordinate on the designated gate
LanguageData.RR_Portals_RememberNatural: Remember this coordinate on the selected door as a permanent natural link
LanguageData.RR_Portals_SelectNaturalDoor: Select a door for a natural link
LanguageData.RR_Portals_NoNaturalDoorCandidates: No eligible door with a clear standable approach was found on this map.
LanguageData.RR_Portals_GateRequired: Designate a native gate with its console, battery and assembly bench before remembering a laboratory address.
LanguageData.RR_Portals_LegacyRepairNeeded: This coordinate was generated before its return threshold became an actual door, so it cannot hold an address yet.
LanguageData.RR_Portals_RepairThreshold: Replace the historical return threshold with an actual door
LanguageData.RR_Portals_RepairExplanation: The site map, its room graph, your construction, recovered items and discoveries are kept. Only the single return-threshold object is replaced, once, against a saved receipt.
LanguageData.RR_Portals_RepairRecorded: Return threshold already repaired under receipt {0}.
LanguageData.RR_Portals_SiteNotLoaded: The saved site is not loaded, so its threshold cannot be repaired now.
LanguageData.RR_Portals_CrossingPending: Unresolved crossings: {0}. Reconcile them before changing this network.
LanguageData.RR_Portals_TravelExplanation: Select one colonist, then order a crossing on a remembered address. They walk to the saved threshold and cross carrying whatever they are already carrying. Opening a door normally never moves anyone.
LanguageData.RR_Portals_NoSelectedPerson: Select one colonist on this map to order a crossing.
LanguageData.RR_Portals_NoLocalAddresses: No remembered address has a threshold on this map.
LanguageData.RR_Portals_OpenSession: Open the laboratory connection for coordinate {0}
LanguageData.RR_Portals_SessionOpen: Laboratory session {0} is open on address {1}, {2} ticks remaining.
LanguageData.RR_Portals_SessionEmergency: The laboratory session is in an emergency state. People already across stay where they are with everything they carry.
LanguageData.RR_Portals_EmergencyReturn: Pay the physical recovery cost and reopen the same session so people can walk back
LanguageData.RR_PortalTravel_InvalidState: The company branch, connection network or crossing record is unavailable.
LanguageData.RR_PortalTravel_NoPerson: No eligible person is selected on a loaded map.
LanguageData.RR_PortalTravel_AddressUnavailable: That address is not available from this map right now.
LanguageData.RR_PortalTravel_SessionClosed: The laboratory connection for that address is not open.
LanguageData.RR_PortalTravel_EndpointMissing: One of the address endpoints is missing. The record is retained for diagnosis.
LanguageData.RR_PortalTravel_JobDefMissing: The crossing job definition is unavailable in this installation.
LanguageData.RR_PortalTravel_OrderRefused: That person refused the crossing order.
LanguageData.RR_PortalTravel_NoSession: This gate has no saved laboratory session.
LanguageData.RR_PortalTraversal_NotOurPerson: Only this company's own people and animals walk through a gate. Anyone or anything else comes back only by being carried through by one of them.
LanguageData.RR_PortalTraversal_PassengerNotHeld: {0} is still on their own feet, so they cannot be taken through a gate. Down, capture or otherwise actually carry them first.
LanguageData.RR_PortalTraversal_CargoNotCarried: That object is not in the carrier's hands, so it cannot go through a gate with them.
LanguageData.RR_PortalAddress_InvalidState: The company branch or connection network is unavailable.
LanguageData.RR_PortalAddress_GateNotReady: The selected gate is not a designated native gate with valid links.
LanguageData.RR_PortalAddress_HeadquartersRequired: A laboratory address must be remembered on a gate at the company headquarters.
LanguageData.RR_PortalAddress_LocalApproachBlocked: The door's approach cell on this map is blocked.
LanguageData.RR_PortalAddress_LocalThresholdUnavailab: The selected door cannot serve as a threshold. It must be an actual door with a clear, directly adjacent standable cell.
LanguageData.RR_PortalAddress_UnknownCoordinate: That coordinate is not a record of this branch.
LanguageData.RR_PortalAddress_SiteUnavailable: The coordinate's saved site is unavailable. Its records are retained; resolve the site before remembering an address.
LanguageData.RR_PortalAddress_SiteNotLoaded: The coordinate's saved site is not loaded.
LanguageData.RR_PortalAddress_SiteThresholdUnavailabl: The site's return threshold is missing or has moved. The saved route is never redirected to a replacement door.
LanguageData.RR_PortalAddress_LegacyThreshold: This site's return threshold predates actual doors. Repair it explicitly first.
LanguageData.RR_PortalAddress_LegacyAnchorMissing: The historical return threshold object is missing, so there is nothing to replace.
LanguageData.RR_PortalAddress_LegacyGeometryUnsupport: The historical return threshold does not occupy a single cell beside its saved return position.
LanguageData.RR_PortalAddress_CoreDoorUnavailable: The Core door definition is unavailable in this installation.
LanguageData.RR_PortalAddress_CrossingInProgress: An unresolved crossing still references this site. Reconcile it first.
LanguageData.RR_PortalAddress_RepairInterrupted: The threshold repair was interrupted. The site, its graph and its discoveries are retained.
LanguageData.RR_PortalAddress_RepairNotRecorded: The replacement door was placed but its repair could not be recorded. Review the site before remembering an address.
LanguageData.RR_PortalAddress_SameMap: A connection must join two different maps.
LanguageData.RR_PortalAddress_IdentityConflict: A different saved address already uses one of these doors.
LanguageData.RR_PortalAddress_EndpointRejected: One of the endpoints is not an acceptable door with a clear adjacent approach.
LanguageData.RR_PortalAddress_WrongBranch: One of the endpoints is not on a map this branch owns.
LanguageData.RR_PortalAddress_Closed: The laboratory connection is not open for that address.
LanguageData.RR_Event_PortalThresholdRepaired: Return threshold replaced with an actual door at coordinate {0} (receipt {1}).
LanguageData.RR_Company_InvalidRequest: That request is not valid for this branch.
LanguageData.RR_Company_CoordinateLimit: This branch is holding its maximum number of coordinate records. No visited coordinate is ever removed to make room.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_Busy: Another crossing is already being reconciled.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_InvalidState: The company branch or connection network is unavailable.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_InvalidSave: The saved crossing records could not be read. They are retained and crossing is disabled.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_InvalidRequest: That crossing request is not valid.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_SequenceExhausted: This save has exhausted its crossing sequence numbers.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_IdentityConflict: A different crossing already used that operation identity.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_PendingLimit: Too many crossings are unresolved. Reconcile some before starting another.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_PawnInTransit: {0} is already part of an unresolved crossing.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_PawnNotEligible: Only this company's own available people and animals can cross. Drafted, downed, dead, prisoner, enslaved, guest and distressed people cannot, and neither can a downed or panicking animal.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_NotAtSourceThreshold: The person is not standing at the saved threshold cell for that connection.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_SourceAccessDenied: The door on this side cannot be used: it is forbidden, locked or impassable for this person.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_EdgeUnavailable: That connection is not currently available.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_WrongBranch: That connection does not belong to this branch's maps.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_DestinationUnsafe: The arrival cell on the far side is not safe to stand in.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_DestinationSpawnFailed: The arrival was refused on the far side; the person is being returned to the near side.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_DestinationAccessDenie: The far door or allowed area refused this person on arrival; they are being returned to the near side.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_EdgeClosedDuringCleanu: The connection closed during the crossing; the person is being returned to the near side.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_CarryOwnerChanged: The carried item changed hands before the crossing; nothing was moved.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_CargoCustodyFailed: The carried item could not be taken into custody for the crossing.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_CargoRestoreFailed: The original carried item could not be handed back and is held for recovery.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_PawnCustodyFailed: The person could not be taken into custody for the crossing and is held for recovery.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_PawnCustodyMissing: The person is not in the expected custody for this crossing; the record is retained for recovery.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_PawnLocationUnresolved: The person is not at either saved endpoint. The record is retained; no one is teleported to resolve it.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_SourceRecoveryBlocked: The original cell on the near side is blocked, so recovery is waiting.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_EndpointMismatch: The person is not where this crossing expected them to be.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_ReceiptMissing: There is no crossing record with that operation identity.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_ReceiptIdentityChanged: The people, items or maps of that crossing record have changed; it is retained for review.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_RecoveredAtChangedLoca: The person was recovered where they actually are, not at either saved endpoint.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_RecoveryException: Recovery was interrupted; the crossing record and custody are retained.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_UnownedPawn: A saved crossing references a person who is neither present nor in custody. The record is retained.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_UnownedCargo: A saved crossing references an item that is neither carried nor in custody. The record is retained.
LanguageData.RR_PortalCrossing_OrphanedHeldThing: Something is held for a crossing that no longer references it. The record is retained.
LanguageData.RR_Frontier_Discovered: {0} found a door that leads somewhere else. The way through is permanently open and is now a remembered address.
LanguageData.RR_Frontier_Unavailable: Surveying doors is unavailable until this branch is operating.
LanguageData.RR_Frontier_NotADoor: That is not a door this company can study.
LanguageData.RR_Frontier_PlayerBuilt: A door your own people built is not a way onward. Ways onward are found in what was already standing there.
LanguageData.RR_Frontier_IsAMachineGate: That door is already a gate.
LanguageData.RR_Release_Budget: Holding {0} of {1}. A Backrooms level costs a loaded map exactly as a colony does, and the limit is the maximum number of colonies set in Options.
LanguageData.RR_Release_Explanation: Releasing a place closes the way to it for good. A natural gate is open from the moment it is found and stays open, and closing one is the only way to free a slot - but it cannot be opened again, and everything left inside is gone with it. The door remains, and still remembers where it led; it simply leads nowhere now.
LanguageData.RR_Release_NoneHeld: This company is holding no Backrooms levels open.
LanguageData.RR_Release_Confirm:
Close the way to {0}?

THIS CANNOT BE UNDONE. The gate will not open again and this place cannot be reached from it a second time. Everything left inside will be gone: {1} item(s), and anything your people built there.

This frees one of your held places.
LanguageData.RR_Release_Done: {0} is no longer held open. Holding {1}.
LanguageData.RR_Release_ShelvedHeading: Released, and reachable again from the door that found them
LanguageData.RR_Release_ShelvedHint: Select the door that led to one of these and use Open this place again.
LanguageData.RR_Release_UnknownPlace: that place is not on this company's records
LanguageData.RR_Release_NotHeldOpen: that place is not being held open
LanguageData.RR_Release_CrossingInFlight: somebody is part-way through a way into it
LanguageData.RR_Portals_MoveWayInTitle: Move a way into the Backrooms
LanguageData.RR_Portals_MoveWayInConfirm: Uninstalling this door will take the way through with it. Your people will carry the door and the route it holds, and it will work again wherever it is reinstalled on this company's ground.\n\nIf anybody is part-way through it when it comes down, the route will be left broken instead of moved.
LanguageData.RR_Portals_WayThroughMoved: {0} has been installed, and the way through came with it.
LanguageData.RR_Frontier_TooManyGatesHeld: This gate is blocked: your company is holding open too many gates. A Backrooms level costs as much to hold open as a colony does, and you are at your limit. Abandon a colony or a level, or raise the maximum number of colonies in Options, and this door will open.
LanguageData.RR_Frontier_NotInTheBackrooms: Doors only lead elsewhere from inside the Backrooms.
LanguageData.RR_Frontier_IsTheWayBack: That door is the way back. It leads home, not onward.
LanguageData.RR_Frontier_Obstructed: There is no clear space beside that door to work from.
LanguageData.RR_Frontier_AlreadyRecorded: That door is already a remembered address.
LanguageData.RR_Frontier_NoneLeftHere: This space has given up every way onward it has.
LanguageData.RR_Frontier_LeadsNowhere: That door leads nowhere but the next room.
LanguageData.RR_Event_CoordinateReleased: The company stopped holding {0} open. The way in is still there and still remembers where it led.
LanguageData.RR_Event_FrontierDiscovered: A door deeper in was recorded as a permanently open way through to {0}, found from {1}.
LanguageData.RR_PortalAddress_EmergenceAnchorUnavaila: No usable way home is marked. Mark a door on a map you hold as the place a way out can come up.
LanguageData.RR_Portals_SpinUpRunning: Bringing up a connection: {0}% charged. The assigned operator must stay on the console.
LanguageData.RR_PortalTraversal_TooLargeForGate: Too large for this gate. Widen the opening: a one-cell door passes people and working animals, a two-cell door passes pack animals like muffalo and dromedaries, and three cells or more passes anything.
LanguageData.RR_Incursion_Text: {0} followed your people to the door and stepped through {1} behind them. It is in the facility now, and it will behave like anything else that gets inside. Closing a connection before something reaches the threshold is what stops this.
LanguageData.RR_Incursion_NoOpening: A closed gate is a wall.
LanguageData.RR_Incursion_AlreadySpent: Something has already come through on this opening.
LanguageData.RR_Incursion_BandTooLow: This space is not yet bad enough for anything to follow you home.
LanguageData.RR_Incursion_TechTooLow: The gate is not advanced enough to hold a connection something else could use.
LanguageData.RR_Frontier_BeyondNaturalReach: The door goes on, and nothing anybody can walk through goes with it. Whatever is past this is only reachable through a gate of your own.
LanguageData.RR_Portals_RemoveWayInTitle: Remove a way into the Backrooms?
LanguageData.RR_Portals_RemoveWayInConfirm:
This door is a way into the Backrooms, and nobody built it.
Take it out and that access is gone. The space on the other side does not close, and it does not move: you will simply have no way back to it until you find another door in, or build a gate of your own.
Nothing warns you again.
LanguageData.RR_WorldExit_LeaveDesc: Somewhere on the other side of this door is open sky. Whoever is standing here goes through, and comes out somewhere on the map that is not where they started.\n\nIf the company can take on another place, that is where they arrive and it becomes yours. If it is already running as many places as it can, they come out as a caravan and have to make their own way from there.
LanguageData.RR_WorldExit_NotHere: Nothing about this door leads outside. A way out has to be found by surveying one, and this is not one of them.
LanguageData.RR_WorldExit_DoorUnavailable: That door is not standing where it was.
LanguageData.RR_WorldExit_DestinationGone: Whatever was on the other side is no longer anywhere on the map. Nobody has moved.
LanguageData.RR_WorldExit_NoAnchorTile: The company has nowhere on the map to reckon from, so there is no telling where this comes out.
LanguageData.RR_WorldExit_NoTileFound: The survey found the way out but nowhere for it to lead. Nothing on the far side would hold anybody.
LanguageData.RR_WorldExit_NobodyHere: Nobody is standing at this door. Bring whoever is leaving to it first.
LanguageData.RR_WorldExit_CouldNotClaim: The place on the far side could not be taken on. Nobody has moved, and the door is still there.
LanguageData.RR_WorldExit_NoArrivalCell: There is nowhere to stand on the far side. Nobody has moved.
LanguageData.RR_WorldExit_NobodyMoved: Nobody made it through, and everybody is back where they were standing.
LanguageData.RR_WorldExit_CouldNotForm: They could not set out from there. Nobody has moved.
LanguageData.RR_Event_WorldExitFound: A survey found a way out that does not lead back to anywhere the company holds. It comes out somewhere on the map instead.
LanguageData.RR_Event_WorldExitUsed: {0} went out through a door and came out under open sky.
LanguageData.RR_Event_WorldExitClaimed: The company has taken on {0}. Whoever walked out is standing in it.
LanguageData.RR_Event_WorldExitCaravan: The company is already running as many places as it can, so {0} set out on foot instead.
LanguageData.RR_Alert_ContainmentBreachDesc: Something is coming off a holding platform at a site you are not currently looking at.\n\nThe base game warns you about containment on the map you have open. This warns you about every other place the company holds something, because a breach at home while you are watching a crew work is exactly the one you will miss.
LanguageData.RR_Alert_ContainmentUnpoweredDesc: A holding platform with something on it has lost power, at a site you are not currently looking at.\n\nA platform without power will not hold. Restore the power, or move the subject, before it decides to leave.
